Class Hyde34GridReader

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.data.Hyde34GridReader
public class Hyde34GridReader extends Object
Native Esri ASCII Grid (.asc) and NetCDF (.nc) Reader for HYDE 3.4 (History Database of the Global Environment). Supports 5-arc-minute global grids (4320x2160) from -10,000 BC to 2023 AD.
Version:
4.0.0
